title: Final Wavelength Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the equation for lambda prime in terms of lambda, theta, and universal parameters.

title: Final Kinetic Energy Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the equation for the kinetic energy of the recoiled electron.

title: Conservation of Energy
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of the conservation of energy principle in the context of Compton scattering.

title: Conservation of Momentum
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of the conservation of momentum principle in the context of Compton scattering.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Common Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student may incorrectly apply signs in the equations, particularly in the conservation laws.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student may neglect to include the factor of mc or h in the final equations.
